name: Is There a Trick to Making Time Fly?
source:
Mya and Evelyn are two room mates that decide to enter their town's local talent show together as a Magic act. They pass the auditions but now need to get ready for the big show the following Saturday! Will they be able to finish preparing for it in time or will the days fly by before they know it?

[From [url=http://2classybricks.deviantart.com/art/Is-There-a-Trick-to-Making-Time-Fly-NaNo-2015-523860857]DeviantArt[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2015.
translation:
米娅与伊芙琳是室友，她们决定一起参加城镇举办的才艺表演，用魔术作为节目。她们通过了试镜，但必须为下周六的大型演出做好准备！她们能及时准备好吗？还是日子会在不知不觉间飞快流逝？

[摘自[url=http://2classybricks.deviantart.com/art/Is-There-a-Trick-to-Making-Time-Fly-NaNo-2015-523860857]DeviantArt[/url]]

为NaNoRenO 2015创作。
